text_block_list.text: On my day off, I run into Satono Crown in front of the station.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What wonderful timing!
What are your plans for today?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh! In that case, would you mind keeping me company for some shopping?
I have preparations for my trip to Hong Kong, and I'd love your input!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
Because when we go to Hong Kong... um............

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? ...Why can't I say it?
Just tell them, 'You're coming to Hong Kong too'—)

Hong Kong... She must be visiting home. If she's shopping, she
probably wants advice on Japanese souvenirs...
choice_data_list: I can recommend some great souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you... Yes, exactly! I'd like to pick out souvenirs
for Mama and Papa first. I'm counting on your advice!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Well, the purpose roughly aligns with what I need anyway...
I'll tell them about coming along later... Yes, later!)

Traditional Japanese items would probably be best for parents living in Hong Kong.
With that in mind, I decide to look up a few options.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, which one should I pick?
There are plenty of items that would make striking gifts, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hong Kong has plenty of Western sweets as it is... so ideally,
I'd love something with an authentic Japanese feel~
choice_data_list: If you're looking for authentic Japanese gifts, I looked up a few.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Zan hai?! You went out of your way to research them? That's so helpful!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Aha! A traditional wagashi gift set! I had no idea this existed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
This is gorgeous and carries such a classic Japanese charm!
I'm sure my parents will adore it. Thank you so much♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Considering the length of the stay... I'll probably need around three boxes...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since I plan to stay quite a while this time,
I want to stock up on the face masks I normally use.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
After all, skincare products work best when they're the ones
your skin is used to. I don't want to run out while over there.

If she's stocking up in bulk, that'll amount to a whole mountain of items!
I ought to lend a hand here.
choice_data_list: Leave carrying the bags to me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I'm not buying that much.
Still... would you mind holding onto the souvenirs for me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Once I buy gifts for business associates and the like, it really will be a mountain.
I won't have enough hands to carry it all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that should about cover it.
I feel bad making you carry all these bags, though.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Having you here was a huge help, Trainer.
Well then, shall we head back?
choice_data_list: Is there anything else we should check out?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... clothes...?
No, but still—
choice_data_list: We're already here, so let's go take a look.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ............Fufu. You're right, since we're already here♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like menswear options in Japan are somewhat limited.
Not that it's a bad thing, of course, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Could this... perhaps be a business opportunity...?

When she gets that look of deep concentration, her mind is purely on business.
At times like this, the best thing I can do is hand her a notepad.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...OK. If I summarize this and show it to Papa...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm so sorry. I kept you waiting.
Thank you for the notepad too. It was a lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: We have quite a few bags, so why don't we take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... For some reason... even though it's just going back to Hong Kong,
I'm feeling terribly nervous...
choice_data_list: Maybe because it's been a while?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes... that might be part of it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: But surely, even more than that—
choice_data_list: Make sure you get plenty of rest back home.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah... no, in Hong Kong—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
choice_data_list: While you're away, I'll work on new training plans for us.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (You're supposed to come with me.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Why can't I just say it?!
All I have to do is tell them, 'You're coming with me'!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Now, let's go to Hong Kong together!
I've already got our entire itinerary worked out!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: "Together?! I'd love to, but out of the blue like this... it's difficult."

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: "In the first place, why did you go and plan an itinerary on your own...?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: "In the first place, why did you go and plan an itinerary on your own...?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: No... It's nothing...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Ah... I'm terrified... of getting rejected...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (...I've lived through far worse when business negotiations fell apart, yet...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Just imagining this hurts more than any of that...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Asking straight out right now won't work...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(If I'm going to ask, I need to create a situation
where I can draw out the Trainer's true thoughts...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Fine... I'll break through this with the ultimate strategy!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hao! Things are... getting interesting now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: !? A notepad? Why...?
choice_data_list: I thought maybe you came up with a new business idea...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, no... Well... actually, yes.
Maybe I will jot something down. ...Fufu, thanks as always!
